BH: B"H / Boruch Hashem / Blessed is He
content:
<!-- B"H
Boruch Hashem
Blessed is He

Chesed opens every possible gate while the Awtsmoos creates the gate and the traveler anew; Awtsmoos.com may become a living storyboard where one image can call a whole cinematic world into view.
-->
# Phase One — Chesed Brainstorm

Anything useful is allowed in this pass before restraint:

- One dominant composer body instead of separate Prompt / Mode / References cards.
- Large image wells at the top of the creation body.
- Drag/drop anywhere over the composer to add images.
- Tap-to-add image button that opens the existing file path, not a new duplicate asset system.
- Empty state that says exactly what to do: Add image or start with text.
- Added image previews become cinematic tiles rather than tiny chips.
- Clear Replace, Remove, and Add another actions on each image.
- Reorder reference images by drag or explicit arrows where the current contract supports ordering.
- Show first-frame / last-frame roles visually on image tiles when relevant.
- Offer one obvious “Use as first frame” or “Use as reference” action rather than exposing raw technical vocabulary first.
- Prompt textarea directly below or beside media previews.
- Prompt label changes contextually: “Describe the motion” when an image is present, “Describe the shot” for text-only.
- Prompt helper chips become lightweight inline seeds, not a horizontal card carousel.
- Mode control becomes a quiet contextual row generated from actual media state.
- Image addition can automatically recommend reference/frame mode but never silently destroy user intent.
- Advanced settings collapse into one disclosure below the main composer.
- Generate lives inside or immediately after the main composer.
- Provider-disabled state remains truthful but visually calm.
- Glass depth should focus around active media/prompt, with no heavy animated blur.
- Media tiles get soft scanline/edge motion using transform/opacity only.
- Mobile should show media + prompt + generate path in the first one to two thumb scrolls.
- Desktop can become two-column inside one continuous composer: visual board + prompt.
- Keep asset library as a secondary path surfaced from the add-media affordance.
- Allow adding by URL only where the current app already supports it.
- Preserve asset dedupe and in-place replacement semantics.
- Preview cache must invalidate on updated asset versions.
- Media-update browser proof must assert the same asset id receives new bytes where replacement is intended.
- Generate transport must prove the updated asset bytes/URL are what the API receives.
- No provider secret in browser code or payload logs.
